Assets & Resources Advertising Configuration ### 6.1 Notable Ad Assets in `assets/` - `assets/privacy_policy_setting`: - An HTML document bundled directly inside the APK stating: > *"This app provide you advertising services through TradPlus, an mobile ad mediation platform. Hardcoded Ad Configuration & Mediation Architecture Decompilation of `defpackage.af` (line 10) revealed the exact hardcoded default configuration of the **AdTiny** framework: ```json { "dual_auction": { "enabled": false, "max_unselected_ready_show_count": 3, "first_load_ready_wait_timeout_ms": { "app_open": 3000, "interstitial": 0 } }, "runtime": { "retry_interval_ms": 2000, "mute": false, "disable_backup_ad_loading": false, "admob_app_open_preload_buffer_size": 3, "admob_interstitial_preload_buffer_size": 3, "admob_native_preload_buffer_size": 1, "admob_rewarded_preload_buffer_size": 3 }, "primary": { "mediation": "admob", "app_id": "ca-app-pub-3928497305603055~4967395145", "units": { "app_open": "ca-app-pub-3928497305603055/1180279092", "interstitial": "ca-app-pub-3928497305603055/7996407149", "native": "ca-app-pub-3928497305603055/4057162132", "banner": "ca-app-pub-3928497305603055/3768353684" } }, "secondary": { "mediation": "tradplus", "app_id": "", "units": { "app_open": "", "interstitial": "" } } } ``` ### 7.1 Verified AdMob Production Ad Unit IDs | Ad Format | Production Ad Unit ID | Source Location | |---|---|---| | **App Open** | `ca-app-pub-3928497305603055/1180279092` | `defpackage.af:10`, `rc.java:13` | | **Interstitial** | `ca-app-pub-3928497305603055/7996407149` | `defpackage.af:10`, `rc.java:9` | | **Native Advanced** | `ca-app-pub-3928497305603055/4057162132` | `defpackage.af:10`, `rc.java:11` | | **Banner** | `ca-app-pub-3928497305603055/3768353684` | `defpackage.af:10`, `rc.java:12` | | **Rewarded Video** | Dynamically provisioned / configured via Remote Config | `rc.java:10`, `AdsDebugActivity.java:148` | ### 7.2 Interstitial Trigger Placement Sites Discovered in `MainApplication.java:406-417`, the app explicitly pre-registers Interstitial triggers on document close actions: - `"I_CloseFilePdf"` — Triggered when closing a PDF document - `"I_CloseFileWord"` — Triggered when closing a Word (.doc/.docx) document - `"I_CloseFileExcel"` — Triggered when closing an Excel (.xls/.xlsx) spreadsheet - `"I_CloseFilePpt"` — Triggered when closing a PowerPoint (.ppt/.pptx) presentation - `"I_CloseFileEbook"` — Triggered when closing an eBook (.epub/.mobi) - `"I_CloseFileMarkdown"` — Triggered when closing a Markdown (.md) document - `"I_CloseFileTxt"` — Triggered when closing a plain text (.txt) document - `"I_CloseWebBrowser"` — Triggered when closing the built-in browser - `"I_CloseStoragePermission"` — Triggered after permission grant/dismissal --- ## 8. Remote Config & Dual Mediation Control Architecture The application uses **Firebase Remote Config** to remotely override ad networks, unit IDs, and waterfall priority without publishing an app update: ``` Firebase Remote Config Parameter Hierarchy: ├── ads/DualMediation ──> Complete JSON overriding primary/secondary mediation ├── ads/ConfigTiny ──> Legacy AdTiny configuration object ├── ads/UnitIds ──> Unit ID dictionary override ├── app/AdjustEvents ──> Dynamic event token mapping for Adjust ILRD tracking ``` ### 8.1 Dual Mediation Factory (`bk.java` / `tj1.java`) `defpackage.bk` implements `AdsMediationFactoryBuilder`: - If `dual_auction.enabled` is `true`: - `primary` and `secondary` mediations run in parallel. - The engine races `primary` (e.g. AdMob) against `secondary` (e.g. TradPlus or MAX). - Timeout for App Open: 3000 ms; Interstitial: 0 ms. - If `dual_auction.enabled` is `false`: - The app routes exclusively through `primary` mediation (`acVarA`). --- ## 9.
